title: for and since / when ... ? and how long ... ?
titleId: for, since, when, dan how long

cards.text: for + lamanya waktu (two hours, five years, ages). since + titik awal waktu (Monday, 2015, 8 o'clock, I was a child).

examples.en: I've been waiting for two hours.

cards.trap: "Sejak tiga bulan" bukan since three months. Yang benar: for three months.

cards.text: for sering boleh dihilangkan, kecuali di kalimat negatif. Jangan pakai for di depan all (all day, all my life).

examples.en: I've lived here all my life.
examples.id: Saya tinggal di sini seumur hidup. (bukan for all my life)

cards.text: When ...? memakai past simple (kapan dimulai). How long ...? memakai present perfect (sudah berapa lama).

examples.en: When did you start this job? I started in March.
examples.id: Kapan kamu mulai pekerjaan ini? Bulan Maret.

examples.en: How long have you had this job? Since March.

cards.text: It's (atau It's been) + waktu + since ... untuk menyatakan sudah berapa lama sejak sesuatu terakhir terjadi.

examples.en: It's two years since I last saw him.
examples.id: Sudah dua tahun sejak terakhir saya melihatnya.

questions.prompt: I've been learning English ___ six months.
questions.why: six months adalah lamanya waktu, jadi for.
2019 adalah titik awal waktu, jadi since.

questions.prompt: Susun pertanyaan: "Kapan kamu mulai bekerja di sini?"
questions.answer: When did you start working here?
questions.why: Menanyakan kapan (When) memakai past simple: When did you start ...?

questions.prompt: I've lived in this town for all my life.
questions.answer: I have lived in this town all my life.
questions.why: Jangan pakai for di depan all.
Pertanyaan When memakai past simple: did + subjek + kata kerja dasar.

questions.prompt: It's three years ___ I last went to the cinema.
questions.why: Pola It's + waktu + since + kejadian terakhir.

questions.answer: We have been waiting since 8 o'clock
accept: We have been waiting since eight o'clock
We have been waiting since eight
questions.why: Lama kegiatan sampai sekarang memakai present perfect continuous; jam 8 adalah titik awal, jadi since.
ten years adalah lamanya waktu, jadi for.

questions.prompt: How long ___ (it / be) since you visited your grandparents?
questions.why: Polanya How long has it been since + kejadian; bentuk How long is it since juga benar.

questions.prompt: Budi has been studying here since three months.
questions.answer: Budi has been studying here for three months.
questions.why: three months adalah lamanya waktu, jadi pakai for.
